question: Will London's temperature reach more than 22°C on Oct 4, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the maximum air temperature recorded at or near London (51.51°N, 0.13°W) exceeds 22°C at any point strictly after 2026-10-03T23:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-04T23:00:00Z.
- "No": Wins if the maximum air temperature recorded at or near London (51.51°N, 0.13°W) does not exceed 22°C at any point during the same interval.

Clarifications:
- Temperature is measured as the hourly 2 m air temperature (temperature_2m); the day's maximum is derived from all hourly readings within the window. A reading of exactly 22°C does not satisfy the "Yes" condition; the temperature must be strictly greater than 22°C.
